access_notes: Viewed 2026-11-07 (dress research for the 1812 scene). An American white linen high-waisted day dress to the floor with long sleeves puffed at the shoulder, a front-buttoning bodice and a gathered skirt with a narrow frill at the hem.
note: Proposed for the 1812 dress reference sets; not a Chicago or Fort Dearborn record. Added for the 1812 women's dress (T-3464 dress build, tools/human_women_1812.py) from docs/RESEARCH/people-1812-3461/dress.json.
what_it_supplies: an American woman's plain high-waisted linen day dress of the 1810s
what_it_does_not_supply: a dated 1812 example; the range runs to 1820 and the puffed sleeve-heads may be later in it
